decision.explanation: The sources explicitly state Luca Nenna attended the University of Bergen as a graduate student (D2S4) and earned his Ph.D. from Université Paris IX - Dauphine (D1S4, D1S5, D2S13). Additionally, D1S17 explicitly states he can be considered an alumnus of PSL University because he attended one of its constituent universities (Université Paris IX - Dauphine). All three institutions are directly supported by the text as places he attended.
